key_concepts: Hydrosphere is the water part of Earth and covers about three-fourths of its surface
Water cycle continuously moves water between Earth's surface and atmosphere
The Sun is the main heat source that drives evaporation
Evaporation changes liquid water into water vapor, mostly from oceans
Transpiration releases water vapor from plant leaves
Respiration, perspiration, and urination add water from animals and humans to the cycle
Condensation changes water vapor into tiny droplets that form clouds
Precipitation returns water to Earth as rain, hail, snow, or sleet
Most of Earth's water is salty; only a small fraction is fresh and available
The water cycle helps purify water and distribute fresh water
The water cycle supports human health, plant growth, animal growth, and crop production
